statement: SDL PS5 parser decodes two packed touch contacts using report-defined coordinates and sends joystick touch updates; it separately normalizes reported battery capacity/charging status for application consumers.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 1355-1405. Host UI presentation, not physical touchpad or battery accuracy.
